judge_panel.reason: The paper's experimental setup section (Section 3.1) states only that 'FastCentNN is evaluated against the original CentNN under identical parameter settings on two clustering tasks' but never specifies the values of the patience window P, movement threshold τ, or which threshold mode (absolute vs. stage-relative) was used in the experiments reported in Tables 1 and 2. These are novel hyperparameters introduced by FastCentNN that are not part of CentNN, so they cannot be inferred from 'identical parameter settings.'

The paper introduces these as tunable inputs — Algorithm 1 lists "movement threshold τ, patience P" in "Require," and Sec. 2.4 says the threshold "can be configured in two modes. In the absolute mode, τt = τ, whereas in the stage-relative mode, τt = τBr." However, the experimental setup only says "FastCentNN is evaluated against the original CentNN under identical parameter settings" and nowhere reports the actual numeric values of P or τ or which threshold mode was used.

The paper introduces new hyperparameters (patience window $P$, movement threshold $\tau$, and threshold mode) in Section 2.4, but Section 3 completely omits their values for the experiments presented in Tables 1 and 2, confirming the reviewer's claim.
